items.title: Shedeur Sanders: Will play first half in second preseason game
items.description:
Sanders and Deshaun Watson will split first-team reps during joint practices ahead of the Browns' second preseason game against the Bills on Saturday, Aug. 22, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Jamal Adams: Diagnosed with right knee injury
items.description:
Head coach Kevin O'Connell said after Saturday's 13-10 preseason win over the Giants that Adams has been diagnosed with a right knee injury, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Scheduled to play against Vegas on Thursday
items.description:
Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said Saturday that Stroud and the other healthy starters will play in Thursday's preseason game against Las Vegas, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Starts preseason game, takes four carries
items.description:
